control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the line tracker brightness is below 70 %, drive forward at 40 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: Drive through the tunnel and out the other side.

decision_points.condition: the line tracker brightness is below 70 %

branches.outcome: brightness below 70 %: it drives forward at 40 %
brightness 70 % or more: it calls stopAtWall
an obstacle is ahead: it stops

branches.reason: It only reaches followLine when the line tracker reads 70 % or more, so it cannot see black there.

branches.outcome: does not see black: it curves right

uncertainties: Your program does not read the light in the tunnel: the line tracker reads the floor under it, so dim light changes nothing it reads.
You did not say whether a line runs through the tunnel; without one the program curves right on the plain floor.
The program never checks the obstacle sensor while the line tracker is dark, so a wall on the black line would not be seen.
